title: 第731章 万层魔渊第730章 前方那头妖蛟且交给你去试上一试
slug: 人在合欢宗开局成为圣女道侣
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：人在合欢宗，开局成为圣女道侣！第一卷：默认第731章万层魔渊（..la）赫连旭听到云傲天的命令，
脸色微变，嘴角一抽。
他自然知道，云傲天这是在测试他的忠诚度，
也在试他愿不愿意在众人面前低头。
赫连旭捏了捏拳，又缓缓松开，终究还是没有拒绝，
只是深吸一口气，
接过那枚阴煞葫芦，指尖灵力微动，略作祭炼便迈步而出。
只见，
前方百丈之外的沼泽之中，
一头通体暗青、形似蛟龙的大妖正盘踞在泥沼之中。
它周身煞气翻涌，一对竖瞳冰冷地注视着来人。
赫连旭咬紧牙关，
将葫芦口对准那头妖蛟，猛然催动，葫芦之中顿时喷涌出一股浓郁的黑气。
那黑气如同锁链般缠上那妖蛟。
妖蛟猛地挣扎数下，蛟尾拍碎大片泥水！
巨口怒张，发出几声低沉的嘶吼。
可那黑气越缠越紧，如同一张无形的网，将它层层包裹。
片刻之后，
妖蛟挣扎渐弱，那庞大身躯终于缓缓伏下，温顺地低下了头颅。
赫连旭长长吐出一口浊气，额头冒汗，

却还是稳稳地收回阴煞葫芦，转身走到云傲天面前，拱手道：
“圣子大人，不辱使命。”
云傲天微微点头，接过葫芦，
随手将那妖蛟收入其中。
他看了一眼赫连旭，
眼底闪过一丝炙热的满意，淡淡开口：
“不错。有这阴煞葫芦在手。
此地的妖煞之气便不足为惧。继续前进。”
闻言，
人群后方，
一位身着暗青战甲的青年修士眉头紧锁，
低声对身旁同伴道：
“杨道友，你有没有发现，这一路上圣子大人似乎早有准备？”
他的同伴若有所思，微微点头：
“你的意思是……”
“嘘。”
暗青战甲青年竖起一根手指，“我们且跟着就好。”
而此刻的云傲天，凌空而立，
目光穿过那片雾气深处，
嘴角微微扬起，眼底掠过一丝极淡的亮光。

他像是感应到了某种遥远而古老的呼唤，从这片沼泽的某一处传来。
那呼唤很轻，却一直在他脑海中回荡。
越是靠近沼泽腹地，便越清晰。
……
秘境一角，
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Become a saintly Taoist monk in the Hehuan Sect! Volume 1: Default Chapter 731 Ten Thousand Layers of Demonic Abyss (..la) He Lianxu heard Yun Aotian’s order,
His face changed slightly and the corner of his mouth twitched.
He naturally knew that Yun Aotian was testing his loyalty.
He was also testing whether he was willing to bow his head in front of everyone.
He Lianxu clenched his fist and slowly released it. After all, he still did not refuse.
Just take a deep breath,
After taking the Yin evil gourd, the spiritual power of his fingertips moved slightly, and he stepped out after a little practice.
I saw,
In the swamp a hundred feet ahead,
A big demon with a dark green body and a shape like a dragon is entrenched in the mire.
Evil energy surged around its body, and a pair of vertical pupils stared coldly at the visitor.
He Lianxu gritted his teeth,
Aiming the mouth of the gourd at the demonic dragon, he suddenly activated it, and a strong black energy suddenly spewed out from the gourd.
The black energy wrapped around the demonic dragon like a chain.
The monster dragon struggled violently for several times, and its tail smashed up a large area of ​​muddy water!
It opened its huge mouth angrily and let out several low roars.
But the black energy got tighter and tighter, like an invisible net, wrapping it up layer by layer.
After a while,
The monster dragon's struggle gradually weakened, and its huge body finally slowly bowed down, lowering its head meekly.
He Lianxu let out a long breath and sweat broke out on his forehead.
But he still retracted the Yinsha gourd steadily, turned around and walked to Yun Aotian, cupped his hands and said:
"Lord Holy Son, you have fulfilled your mission."
Yun Aotian nodded slightly, took the gourd,
He casually took the monster dragon into it.
He glanced at He Lianxu and said,
A trace of hot satisfaction flashed in his eyes, and he spoke lightly:
"That's right. I have this Yin evil gourd in hand.
The evil spirit here is nothing to be afraid of. Keep going. "
Hearing this,
behind the crowd,
A young monk wearing dark green armor frowned.
He whispered to his companion beside him:
"Fellow Daoist Yang, have you noticed that the Holy Son seems to have been prepared for this journey?"
His companion was thoughtful and nodded slightly:
"You mean..."
"Shhh."
The young man in dark green armor raised a finger, "We can just follow."
At this moment, Yun Aotian is standing in the sky,
Looking through the depths of the mist,
The corners of his mouth were raised slightly, and a faint light flashed across his eyes.
He seemed to sense some distant and ancient call coming from somewhere in this swamp.
The call was very soft, but it kept echoing in his mind.
The closer you get to the hinterland of the swamp, the clearer it becomes.
…
A corner of the secret realm,
